title: Signup Checkbox STILL causes infinite loop (BUG-027 fix failed)
description: BUG-027 was marked complete but the checkbox still causes 'Maximum update depth exceeded'. Previous fixes (stopPropagation, pointer-events-none) did not work. Need fresh investigation.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Reproduce: Go to /signup, click anywhere on the checkbox card
Investigate: The error comes from setRef in Radix internals, not onClick handlers
Check: Label htmlFor='migrate' may be triggering checkbox programmatically
Check: Radix Checkbox internal state management with controlled checked prop
Fix: Checkbox card can be clicked without any console errors
Fix: Checkbox toggles state correctly on click
Fix: Rapid clicking does not cause errors
Verify in browser: Full signup flow works with checkbox checked and unchecked

notes: FIXED: Replaced Radix Checkbox with a simple custom div + lucide-react Check icon. The root cause was Radix Checkbox's internal ref/state management conflicting with React's controlled component pattern when the checked prop changed rapidly. By using a plain div with conditional rendering of a Check icon, we avoid all of Radix's internal complexity while maintaining the same visual appearance.
